free_text: The patient is a 57-year-old male with a significantly elevated PSA of 190.0 ng/mL and a prior biopsy showing Gleason 4+3 disease, classified as ISUP grade group 3. MRI demonstrated a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left apical peripheral zone, with no evidence of extracapsular extension. The patient has chronic kidney disease. Management requires clinical review of individual treatment benefit given the documented grade and extent of the prostate cancer.
